title: education-data
description: Bilingual (EN+ZH) education data: 299 universities, 234 intl schools, degree-ROI, sourced answers.
summary: Bilingual (EN+ZH) education data: 299 universities, 234 intl schools, degree-ROI, sourced answers.
offersHint: Bilingual (EN+ZH) education data: 299 universities, 234 intl schools, degree-ROI, sourced answers. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://brightkey.co/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_universities
toolsPreview.description: List BrightKey-profiled universities with optional filters. Returns slug, name, country, city, 6-dimension S/A/B/C/D tiers, and verdict.

toolsPreview.name: get_university_profile
toolsPreview.description: Full BrightKey profile for one university by slug: tier ratings + why, verdict, strengths/weaknesses, cost estimate, admissions tips. Bilingual.

toolsPreview.name: compare_universities
toolsPreview.description: Compare 2 universities on BrightKey's 6 dimensions. Returns per-dimension tier deltas + a sourced tier-delta paragraph (tiers, not a single rank).

toolsPreview.name: degree_roi
toolsPreview.description: 5-year-after-graduation net ROI + break-even year for a degree. Pass a preset country slug (e.g. germany, uk-oxbridge, us-private) or 'all' for the ranked list.

toolsPreview.name: match_schools
toolsPreview.description: List BrightKey-profiled international schools, filtered by city and/or curriculum (e.g. IB, A-Levels, AP). Returns name, curricula, fees, inspection rating, tiers.

toolsPreview.name: answer_education_question
toolsPreview.description: Search BrightKey's cited answers to common international-education questions (curriculum, schools, universities, visas, process). Returns the best-match sourced answer.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search across universities, schools, and answers. Returns {id, title, url} results; pass an id to fetch().

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch full content for an id returned by search (uni:<slug>, school:<city>/<slug>, answer:<slug>).
